text: Owner decision 2026-09-26: ship on the JVM with JavaFX, portable by construction (DESIGN_SPEC §13). studio-core, studio-app (Elm-style UI-neutral presentation) and studio-viz are cross-built JVM+Scala.js and linked for JS in CI. studio-desktop is a thin JavaFX shell over view-models and intents. The StudyBackend protocol is serializable, with in-process and IPC transports. Alternatives considered: (a) a JavaFX-only monolith: faster to start, but a port would mean a rewrite. (b) Web-first (Electron or Tauri): conflicts with the decided JavaFX/scaladock/Intaglio host and gives up native canvas performance now. Chosen: JDK 25 LTS for studio-desktop (JavaFX 24 needs JDK >= 22); the cross projects keep the core JDK target; Scala 3.7.4; sbt 1.12.14. Also decided: OffScreenPolicy defaults to ExcludeRecord (configurable; its own 'outside screen' tally), and occurrence selection applies to the control pool.
